verdict.rationale: Close documents an official MCP server that gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar tools no-code access to Close data. Its read, write_safe and write_destructive scopes let users read, write and delete CRM data through natural-language prompts in those external AI clients. The language interpretation, however, happens in third-party assistants rather than a native command interface, and Chloe is described as an autonomous calling and qualifying agent, not a natural-language way to operate the product. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations are reachable by natural language, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
